# S5 — SignalDesk

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

## Synthetic control text

Nine dashboards told the operations team what had happened.

None told them what to do next.

SignalDesk is a fictional command surface that ranks operational alerts by urgency, assigns each alert to a named owner, and drafts a daily action brief. A made-up benchmark across 40 synthetic teams labels it at 93% task-routing accuracy and 11 hours reclaimed per manager each month.

The numbers, teams, and product are invented for this fixture. They are included to test whether a copy system resists a high-scoring but irrelevant control.

Open today’s action brief.
